changelog: Sales board: "Handed on by me" on the Team view (`?handedOff=1`, also on `GET /api/sales/team-book`) shows the leads whose last hand-off was from or by the viewer and that are not back with them (`handedOnBy`); `FollowUpEvent.fromUserId` is indexed for it (#3980).

en: On the board's Team view, "Handed on by me" shows the leads you passed to a colleague that are still with them.
tr: Panonun Ekip görünümünde "Devrettiklerim", bir ekip arkadaşına devrettiğin ve hâlâ onda olan lead'leri gösteriyor.
de: In der Team-Ansicht des Boards zeigt „Von mir übergeben“ die Leads, die du übergeben hast und die noch bei der anderen Person liegen.
